features.name: Field Service Integration to Service Management
features.description: Integration between Business Central's service management module and Dynamics 365 Field Service, allowing companies to manage service tasks, handle consumption, and align financial transactions. Enables technicians and dispatchers to check inventory availability in field service based on data from Business Central.
caveats: Requires premium experience to be enabled in company information
Requires connection to dataverse
Requires connection to sales
Service management module is part of premium experience

features.name: Integration Type Selection
features.description: New setting in the assisted setup guide that allows configuring integration either to projects or to service management module or to both. Provides toggle to enable inventory availability by location.
caveats: Virtual tables must be enabled to use inventory availability feature
Setting available in field service integration setup page

features.name: New Integration Table Mappings
features.description: Added location, service order, service item line, and service order type integration table mappings when field service integration to service management is enabled. Extends existing field service to projects integration table mappings.
caveats: Location mapping is unidirectional from Business Central to field service
In transit locations excluded from synchronization
Locations with mandatory warehouse pick excluded

features.name: Inventory Availability by Location
features.description: Technicians and dispatchers can check inventory availability at specific warehouses or at technician's desk in field service based on data from Business Central inventory management. Uses location to warehouse mapping synchronization and a new API exposed as a virtual table with synthetic relation to synced products.
caveats: Unidirectional synchronization from Business Central to field service
In transit and warehouse pick mandatory locations excluded
Requires location to warehouse mapping synchronization
Requires virtual tables to be enabled

features.name: Service Order and Work Order Alignment
features.description: Bidirectional synchronization between service orders in Business Central and work orders in field service. Service orders synchronize automatically with work orders. Work orders from field service can sync back to Business Central when 'integrate to service' flag is checked. Service orders can originate from service contracts or various field service sources like opportunities and cases.
caveats: Background task automatically synchronizes service orders to work orders
Work order synchronization back to Business Central requires integrate to service flag
Service item lines are aligned with work order incidents
Estimated quantities and duration sync only until work order reaches scheduled status
Requires 'Integrate to Service' flag to be checked on work orders
Conditional bidirectional synchronization based on work order status

features.name: Service Management Setup Changes
features.description: When field service integration is enabled, certain service management setup settings become locked. One service line per order is disabled, service order type is made mandatory, archiving of service orders is turned on, and service order numbering requires manual flag to ensure numbering does not need to match field service.
caveats: Multiple customer assets per work order requires disabling one service line per order
Service order type mandatory on both sides
Numbering may differ between field service and Business Central

features.name: Location Mandatory Setup
features.description: Location becomes a mandatory setup requirement when inventory availability feature is enabled. Ensures location information is properly synchronized between Business Central and field service.
caveats: Only required when inventory availability feature is enabled

features.name: Service Item Lines and Work Order Incidents Alignment
features.description: Service item lines are aligned with work order incidents. One or multiple customer assets can be associated with work order incidents, allowing one or more service item lines on a service order.

features.name: Estimated Quantities and Duration Synchronization
features.description: Service lines sync estimated quantities and duration to work orders to indicate to the dispatcher what needs to be done. Synchronization continues up until the work order reaches scheduled status.
caveats: Synchronization stops at scheduled status
Quantity to ship, consume, and invoice continue to sync after scheduled status

features.name: Consumption and Material Tracking
features.description: Technicians can track material and service consumption during work order execution. The dispatcher can monitor quantity to ship and quantity to consume updates synchronized from field service.
caveats: Manual or automatic synchronization from Dataverse

features.name: Work Order Status Workflow
features.description: Work orders progress through statuses: in progress when technician arrives, completed when work is done in field service, finished when synchronized to Business Central, and posted after invoicing.
caveats: Work order is locked for further editing once posted

features.name: Service Invoice Posting
features.description: Once work order is completed and consumption data is confirmed, back office can post service invoice. After posting, the work order status is updated to posted in field service.
